anomalies.description: Dashcam footage shows a large truck veering sharply right and colliding with the guardrail or embankment on the highway shoulder, resulting in a violent impact and visible vehicle deformation.

A large, rapidly expanding fireball erupts on the left shoulder of the highway, consistent with a catastrophic explosion of a gas-carrying truck. The fireball grows in size and intensity from frame f0 to f9, reaching peak expansion around f7–f8, then begins to collapse and transition into a burning mass with thick smoke by f10.

The explosion originates from a truck (visible as a dark silhouette ahead on the road) that has likely crashed or ruptured, resulting in a catastrophic failure. The sustained fire and smoke at the location of the truck across all frames indicate a vehicle incident leading directly to the explosion and fire.
A truck is seen stationary or heavily damaged on the left shoulder with intense fire and smoke, indicating it has crashed and caught fire; the explosion likely resulted from the crash.
Large fireball and thick black smoke erupting from the left roadside, consistent with a sudden violent explosion of a vehicle or cargo.
A large fireball erupts on the left side of the road, rapidly expanding and brightening over several frames, consistent with a high-energy explosion.
